binary_packages: null in every record: the compose source repodata does not list binary RPM names
role_rule_notes: signature = .asc/.sig/.sign/.gpg/.pgp suffix or a non-archive keyring file
rust-<crate> packages: the .crate whose name matches the package is primary (the upstream-version one if several); other crates unknown (rust-*) or vendor_bundle
vendor_bundle = archive filename contains vendor / crate(s) / -nm-prod|-nm-dev / node_modules

primary otherwise = best-evidenced non-signature, non-vendor, non-patch archive in the dist-git sources file, ranked by: filename contains upstream version, contains a package-name stem, lacks auxiliary marker (docs/data/tests...), then file position (not spec Source index)
other archives: component if the filename carries the package name or upstream version, else unknown
lookaside URLs are the Fedora lookaside cache locations derived from the declared digest
